description: Analyze deployed EVM runtime bytecode locally with EVMole. Extract function selectors, inferred arguments and mutability, persistent or transient storage access, metadata, disassembly, basic blocks, or a control-flow graph. This tool does not fetch contracts, decode calldata, verify source code, or fully decompile a contract.

bytecode.description: Deployed EVM runtime bytecode as hexadecimal; maximum 1 MiB.

include.description: Analysis features to include: selectors, arguments, stateMutability, storage, transientStorage, metadata, disassembly, basicBlocks, controlFlowGraph. arguments and stateMutability imply selectors.

name: analyze_evm_bytecode
title: Analyze EVM bytecode
